Card Q&A.q: If only I have a level 4 or lower Digimon, can I choose to not activate this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect and not delete my level 4 or lower Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 level 4 or lower Digimon.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect deletes another Digimon, you may play 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card with the [Undead] or [Dark Animal] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
